==Ingredients==

* 1 regular package [[Cookbook:Cake Mix|brownie mix]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
* ¼ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]]
* 10 miniature [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] candy bars, chopped

==Procedure==

# Prepare brownie mix according to package directions, reducing oil to 3 tablespoons.
# Pour into lightly greased 9-by-3-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|pan]].
# Spread condensed milk over the brownie batter.
# Sprinkle with chopped nuts and candy bars.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]] for 35–38 minutes or until done.
# Cool completely and cut into bars.
